notes: HOTFIX on top of 2.28.5, nothing else changed. When the engineer could not reach the AI, a weather question got you a fuel summary - he knew only a few words for weather, so the Polish prognoza pogody and the same question in many other languages fell through. He now recognises weather questions in far more languages, and asking how much regen your hybrid has no longer gets you a weather report. In Le Mans Ultimate and rF2 he now tells you what the weather is doing right now - rain, how wet the track is and the air and track temperature - and says honestly that the game gives no forecast, where before he said he had no weather data at all. ACC and F1 rain forecasts are now spoken in your language instead of dropping into English. The LMU weather part was checked against the game's data layout, not yet out on track, so if the engineer says something odd, please use the feedback form in the app.
